_purpose: Predefined, bounded PAPER_AUTONOMOUS risk policy. The bot executes eligible strategies WITHOUT per-trade or per-coin manual approval, but every entry/exit is validated against these hard limits by the independent risk layer (app/risk/policy.py + PaperAutonomous.confirm_trade_entry). This is autonomous execution inside a policy, not unrestricted trading. PAPER ONLY.

authorization.paper_autonomous: APPROVED_BY_OWNER (directive 2026-10-21): automatic BUY/SELL/HOLD/EXIT for eligible crypto in Alpaca PAPER without per-trade approval.

per_position.sizing: Quantity derived from the actual stop distance where applicable; stake is reduced further if the stop distance would breach max_planned_loss_usd.

portfolio.reported_buying_power_note: The paper account may report ~$400,000 buying power. That is NOT usable: the independent $10,000 / 10%-equity exposure cap is the real bound.

circuit_breakers.disclaimer: A loss limit does not guarantee an exact maximum loss; slippage, gaps, API failures and execution latency can produce worse results.

executors.note: Two DISJOINT PAPER order executors run concurrently (owner directive 2026-10-21 to trade the experimental alts fast/intraday). 'daily' = BTC baseline only (1d Z-score, stake 5000). 'fast' = ETH/XRP/DOT/LINK (5m momentum, stake 1000 each). Each Freqtrade process only sees its own trade DB, so the read-only monitor writes app/state/open_exposure.json and every confirm_trade_entry adds the OTHER executor's open stake before the exposure-cap check (fail-closed if the ledger is stale) — the $10k / 10%-equity cap stays global, not per-process. Pair sets are disjoint (no duplicate orders) and the structural worst case is 5000 + 4x1000 = 9000 <= 10000 with 1 + 4 = 5 <= 5 positions.

fail_closed: Stale or unavailable market data / equity snapshot.
An unresolved order or open position already exists for the pair.
Any portfolio or per-position limit would be breached.
configurability: All amounts and percentages above are the source of truth and are validated at startup by app/scripts/preflight.py. Changing any limit requires a new owner-approved revision.
